data.title: Lavita
data.about:
Welcome to Lavita at The Oasis, a prestigious residential development by Emaar Properties, where tranquility and luxury seamlessly come together. Each grand mansion within this community is a masterpiece, offering a harmonious blend of sophisticated design and serene living. Nestled alongside peaceful waterways, the 6 and 7-bedroom mansions provide panoramic views of shimmering lakes, lush parks, and serene water canals.

Lavita at the Oasis By Emaar's expansive layouts and modern architectural style are designed to provide a sense of exclusivity and refinement. With top-tier amenities and a peaceful environment, it’s the perfect choice for those who seek both luxury and tranquility.

characteristics_module.title: Lavita The Oasis: A Retreat of Timeless Luxury and Tranquility
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Lavita Oasis location along the waterways with 6 and 7-bedroom luxury mansions.
  • The community features world-class facilities such as pools, parks, and extensive green spaces.
  • Lavita The Oasis offers high rental yields and significant capital appreciation, making it a smart choice for investors.
  • Emaar Properties brings decades of experience and a reputation for excellence to Lavita at The Oasis.
  • The Oasis offers a serene living experience with stunning water features, including tranquil canals, shimmering lakes, and private beaches.

location_tile.title: The Oasis: A Sanctuary of Elegance and Tranquility
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The Oasis, by Emaar Properties, is a serene residential retreat that perfectly balances elegance and tranquility. This luxurious community is centered around peaceful waterways, lush landscapes, and shimmering lakes, creating a picturesque setting for its grand residences. 

The Oasis is strategically situated in a prime area of Dubai, a short drive from the the vibrant downtown district. Moreover, it enjoys proximity to the new Al Khail Road expansion & Sheikh Zayed bin Hamdan Road. 

  • 20 Minutes - Arabian Ranches
  • 30 Minutes - Dubai Hills Mall
  • 40 Minutes - Dubai International Airport
  • 40 Minutes - Downtown Dubai

seo.metaTitle: Lavita at The Oasis By Emaar
seo.metaDescription: Discover luxury mansions along tranquil waterways in Lavita at The Oasis. Find out all about the new development by Emaar Properties.

more_info.answer: Lavita at The Oasis by Emaar offers a range of luxury villas, townhouses, and mansions with 6 and 7 bedrooms, designed for those seeking modern elegance and expansive living spaces.
more_info.question: What types of homes are available at Lavita at The Oasis by Emaar?

more_info.answer: Yes, Emaar Lavita at The Oasis is an exceptional investment opportunity, offering a luxurious lifestyle amidst tranquility, making it highly desirable with a promising return on investment.
more_info.question: Is Lavita at The Oasis by Emaar a good investment?

more_info.answer: Lavita Villas at The Oasis Dubai are ideally located near Sheikh Zayed bin Hamdan Road, providing seamless connectivity to major areas in the city and beyond.
more_info.question: Where is Lavita at The Oasis located?

more_info.answer: The Lavita at The Oasis masterplan spans over 100 million square feet, featuring more than 7,000 residences. It boasts serene water canals, lush parks, and sandy beaches, offering a waterfront living experience in Lavita at The Oasis.
more_info.question: What is unique about the Lavita at The Oasis master plan?

more_info.answer: The area has various projects under development, including Palmiera 2, Mirage The Oasis, and Lagoons Venice.
